name: Admin Client Email Copy Settings
description: Admin manages the independent universal BCC recipient catalog under /panel/emails?tab=defaults. Each recipient can be added, paused, activated, removed and segmented across proposals, diagnostics, documents/communications, collection accounts, accounting, platform, tasks/operations and security/access. The view explains hidden-copy privacy, security-body visibility and volume impact. Validation and server failures remain visible without claiming a change succeeded.
